lei_record.legal_name: JOHNSON CONTROLS INTERNATIONAL PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANY

revenue_model.description: The company sells commercial HVAC equipment, controls, security, fire detection and suppression systems, and digital software solutions primarily to commercial, industrial, data center, institutional, governmental, and residential customers through a direct global sales and service network and third-party distributors. It also provides technical services including maintenance, repair, retrofit, replacement, and energy management consulting, with recurring revenue from digital and data-driven smart building services.
revenue_model.quote: The Company sells and installs its commercial HVAC equipment and systems, control systems, security systems, fire-detection and fire suppression systems, equipment and services primarily through its extensive direct channel

business_structure.description: Johnson Controls International plc is a publicly listed company organized as a plc. It operates through three regional reporting segments: Americas, EMEA, and APAC, each responsible for designing, manufacturing, selling, installing, and servicing building products and digital solutions in their respective geographic markets.
business_structure.quote: The Company conducts its business through three operating segments, all of which are reportable segments: Americas, EMEA and APAC
